section.p: Consider a procedure where the author has inserted an admonition between two numbered steps to call out a safety or precautionary detail relevant to the step just completed.

section.p: Result: The converter treats the admonition <div> as supporting information tied to the preceding step and nests it inside <info><note> rather than splitting the procedure into two separate <steps> blocks. The class attribute (warning, note, etc.) determines the type attribute of the generated <note>.
